name: sim-board
description: A shared board of iOS Simulators for UI tests: which are booted, free, or claimed by which Claude Code session, with claim/release tools and a guard that stops sessions testing on each other's simulators

filter.title: Simulator filter
filter.description: Only list simulators whose name or runtime matches this regular expression (case-insensitive); empty lists all

staleMinutes.title: Stale claim minutes
staleMinutes.description: A claim whose session has not checked in for this many minutes may be taken over
